```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(shiny)

# Determine root path prefix
if (dir.exists('../data/imputed_sets')) {
  root_prefix <- '..'
} else if (dir.exists('data/imputed_sets')) {
  root_prefix <- '.'
} else {
  stop("Could not locate data/imputed_sets/ directory")
}

TEST_DIR <- "joint_twostage_pool_test"
TEST_JOINT_MODEL <- "JointTwoStagePool"
KNN_TEST_DIR <- "joint_knn3_pool_test"
KNN_TEST_MODEL <- "JointKNN3Pool"
TEST_HISTORY_START_DATE <- as.Date("2025-11-19")

# Load ground truth
data_dir <- file.path(root_prefix, 'data/imputed_sets')

# Helper: latest file by pattern
latest_file <- function(dir, pattern) {
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  files[order(files)][length(files)]
}

actual_path <- latest_file(data_dir, '^imputed_and_stitched_hosp_.*\\.csv$')
actual_raw <- read_csv(actual_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# FIPS mappings
location_to_fips <- c(
  'Alabama'='01','Alaska'='02','Arizona'='04','Arkansas'='05','California'='06','Colorado'='08',
  'Connecticut'='09','Delaware'='10','District of Columbia'='11','Florida'='12','Georgia'='13',
  'Hawaii'='15','Idaho'='16','Illinois'='17','Indiana'='18','Iowa'='19','Kansas'='20',
  'Kentucky'='21','Louisiana'='22','Maine'='23','Maryland'='24','Massachusetts'='25',
  'Michigan'='26','Minnesota'='27','Mississippi'='28','Missouri'='29','Montana'='30',
  'Nebraska'='31','Nevada'='32','New Hampshire'='33','New Jersey'='34','New Mexico'='35',
  'New York'='36','North Carolina'='37','North Dakota'='38','Ohio'='39','Oklahoma'='40',
  'Oregon'='41','Pennsylvania'='42','Puerto Rico'='72','Rhode Island'='44','South Carolina'='45',
  'South Dakota'='46','Tennessee'='47','Texas'='48','Utah'='49','Vermont'='50','Virginia'='51',
  'Washington'='53','West Virginia'='54','Wisconsin'='55','Wyoming'='56','US'='US'
)
fips_to_name <- setNames(names(location_to_fips), location_to_fips)

# All state names (excluding US and PR for state selector)
all_states <- sort(names(location_to_fips)[!names(location_to_fips) %in% c('US', 'Puerto Rico')])

# Prepare ground truth (since 2024-09-01 for current season context)
actual_data <- actual_raw %>%
  transmute(
    location = location_to_fips[location_name],
    location_name = location_name,
    date = as.Date(date),
    actual_value = total_hosp
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(location), !is.na(actual_value), date >= as.Date('2024-09-01'))

# Prospective directory
prosp_dir <- file.path(root_prefix, 'forecasts/prospective')
test_output_dir <- file.path(root_prefix, TEST_DIR, 'outputs')
knn_test_output_dir <- file.path(root_prefix, KNN_TEST_DIR, 'outputs')
test_hedge_prosp_dir <- file.path(test_output_dir, 'ensemble_hedge')

# Helper to load ALL prospective forecast files matching a pattern (returns list by date)
# Base model filenames use prior Saturday, but we convert to CDC reference date (upcoming Saturday)
load_all_prosp_files <- function(base_pattern, model_name, file_horizon) {
  # Pattern like: ARIMA_h1_prospective_(\d{8})\.csv
  full_pattern <- sprintf('%s_prospective_(\\d{8})\\.csv', base_pattern)
  files <- list.files(prosp_dir, pattern = full_pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NULL)

  result <- lapply(files, function(path) {
    # Extract date from filename (base model date = prior Saturday)
    ts_match <- regexpr("\\d{8}", basename(path))
    base_date_str <- regmatches(basename(path), ts_match)

    # Convert to CDC reference date (add 7 days)
    cdc_date <- as.Date(base_date_str, format = '%Y%m%d') + 7
    cdc_date_str <- format(cdc_date, '%Y%m%d')

    tryCatch({
      df <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        filter(output_type == 'quantile') %>%
        mutate(
          model = model_name,
          forecast_date = cdc_date_str,  # Use CDC reference date for consistency
          reference_date = as.Date(reference_date),
          target_end_date = as.Date(target_end_date),
          location = as.character(location),
          output_type_id = as.numeric(output_type_id),
          value = as.numeric(value),
          horizon = file_horizon
        ) %>%
        select(model, forecast_date, reference_date, horizon, target_end_date, location, output_type_id, value)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  })

  bind_rows(result)
}

load_test_joint_prosp_file <- function() {
  files <- list.files(test_output_dir, pattern = '^prospective.*\\.csv$', full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NULL)

  file_info <- file.info(files)
  latest_path <- files[order(file_info$mtime, decreasing = TRUE)][1]

  tryCatch({
    read_csv(latest_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      filter(output_type == 'quantile') %>%
      mutate(
        model = TEST_JOINT_MODEL,
        forecast_date = format(as.Date(reference_date), '%Y%m%d'),
        reference_date = as.Date(reference_date),
        target_end_date = as.Date(target_end_date),
        location = as.character(location),
        output_type_id = as.numeric(output_type_id),
        value = as.numeric(value),
        horizon = as.integer(horizon) + 1L
      ) %>%
      select(model, forecast_date, reference_date, horizon, target_end_date, location, output_type_id, value)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(sprintf("Could not load test joint prospective file %s: %s", basename(latest_path), e$message))
    NULL
  })
}

load_test_joint_backtest_file <- function() {
  files <- list.files(test_output_dir, pattern = '^backtest_cov.*\\.csv$', full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NULL)

  file_info <- file.info(files)
  latest_path <- files[order(file_info$mtime, decreasing = TRUE)][1]

  tryCatch({
    read_csv(latest_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      filter(output_type == 'quantile') %>%
      mutate(
        model = paste0(TEST_JOINT_MODEL, '-backtest'),
        forecast_date = format(as.Date(reference_date), '%Y%m%d'),
        reference_date = as.Date(reference_date),
        target_end_date = as.Date(target_end_date),
        location = as.character(location),
        output_type_id = as.numeric(output_type_id),
        value = as.numeric(value),
        horizon = as.integer(horizon) + 1L
      ) %>%
      filter(reference_date >= TEST_HISTORY_START_DATE) %>%
      select(model, forecast_date, reference_date, horizon, target_end_date, location, output_type_id, value)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(sprintf("Could not load test joint backtest file %s: %s", basename(latest_path), e$message))
    NULL
  })
}

load_test_hedge_backtest_files <- function() {
  files <- list.files(
    file.path(test_output_dir, 'ensemble_hedge_retrospective'),
    pattern = '^AdaptiveEnsemble_hedge_retrospective_\\d{8}\\.csv$',
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NULL)

  result <- lapply(files, function(path) {
    ts_match <- regexpr("\\d{8}", basename(path))
    cdc_date_str <- regmatches(basename(path), ts_match)

    tryCatch({
      read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        filter(output_type == 'quantile') %>%
      mutate(
        model = 'AdaptiveEnsemble-hedge-test-backtest',
        forecast_date = cdc_date_str,
        reference_date = as.Date(reference_date),
          target_end_date = as.Date(target_end_date),
          location = as.character(location),
        output_type_id = as.numeric(output_type_id),
        value = as.numeric(value),
        horizon = as.integer(horizon) + 1L
      ) %>%
        filter(reference_date >= TEST_HISTORY_START_DATE) %>%
        select(model, forecast_date, reference_date, horizon, target_end_date, location, output_type_id, value)
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(sprintf("Could not load test hedge backtest file %s: %s", basename(path), e$message))
      NULL
    })
  })

  bind_rows(result)
}

# Load all prospective forecasts for all dates
all_forecasts <- list()

for (h in 1:4) {
  # ARIMA
  all_forecasts[[paste0('ARIMA_h', h)]] <- load_all_prosp_files(
    sprintf('ARIMA_h%d', h), 'ARIMA', h)

  # SVM
  all_forecasts[[paste0('SVM_h', h)]] <- load_all_prosp_files(
    sprintf('SVM_h%d', h), 'SVM', h)

  # LGBM Blended (t10+t100+persistence with conformal CIs)
  all_forecasts[[paste0('LGBM_blended_h', h)]] <- load_all_prosp_files(
    sprintf('LGBM-blended_h%d', h), 'LGBM-blended', h)

  # LGBM bounded
  all_forecasts[[paste0('LGBM_bounded_h', h)]] <- load_all_prosp_files(
    sprintf('TwoStage-FrozenMu-bounded_h%d', h), 'LGBM-bounded', h)

  # LGBM bounded wide variants 1-5
  for (v in 1:5) {
    all_forecasts[[paste0('LGBM_bounded_wide_', v, '_h', h)]] <- load_all_prosp_files(
      sprintf('TwoStage-FrozenMu-bounded-wide-%d_h%d', v, h),
      sprintf('LGBM-bounded-wide-%d', v), h)
  }

  # LGBM bounded wide 4 non-enhanced (uses default state lag features)
  all_forecasts[[paste0('LGBM_bounded_wide_4_ne_h', h)]] <- load_all_prosp_files(
    sprintf('TwoStage-FrozenMu-bounded-wide-4-ne_h%d', h),
    'LGBM-bounded-wide-4-ne', h)
}

# Adaptive Ensemble - fetch historical from GitHub, use local only for latest
# All forecast_date values now use CDC reference date convention (upcoming Saturday, YYYYMMDD)

github_base_url <- 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cdcepi/FluSight-forecast-hub/main/model-output/MIGHTE-Nsemble'

# 2024-25 season CDC dates available on GitHub
github_ensemble_dates <- c('2025-11-22', '2025-11-29', '2025-12-06', '2025-12-13', '2025-12-20', '2025-12-27', '2026-01-03', '2026-01-10')

# Find all local ensemble files (uses CDC date convention)
local_ens_files <- list.files(prosp_dir, pattern = '^AdaptiveEnsemble_prospective_\\d{8}\\.csv$', full.names = TRUE)
local_hedge_files <- list.files(prosp_dir, pattern = '^AdaptiveEnsemble-hedge_prospective_\\d{8}\\.csv$', full.names = TRUE)
local_meta_files <- list.files(prosp_dir, pattern = '^AdaptiveEnsemble-meta_prospective_\\d{8}\\.csv$', full.names = TRUE)
test_hedge_files <- list.files(test_hedge_prosp_dir, pattern = '^AdaptiveEnsemble-hedge_prospective_\\d{8}\\.csv$', full.names = TRUE)
local_ens_dates <- if (length(local_ens_files) > 0) {
  sapply(local_ens_files, function(f) {
    m <- regexpr("\\d{8}", basename(f))
    regmatches(basename(f), m)
  })
} else {
  character(0)
}

# Load historical ensemble from GitHub
ens_list <- list()

for (cdc_date in github_ensemble_dates) {
  # Convert to YYYYMMDD format for forecast_date
  cdc_date_str <- gsub('-', '', cdc_date)

  # Skip if we have a local file for this date (prefer local files)
  if (cdc_date_str %in% local_ens_dates) next

  url <- sprintf('%s/%s-MIGHTE-Nsemble.csv', github_base_url, cdc_date)

  tryCatch({
    df <- read_csv(url, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      filter(output_type == 'quantile') %>%
      mutate(
        model = 'AdaptiveEnsemble',
        forecast_date = cdc_date_str,  # Use CDC date (YYYYMMDD)
        reference_date = as.Date(reference_date),
        target_end_date = as.Date(target_end_date),
        location = as.character(location),
        output_type_id = as.numeric(output_type_id),
        value = as.numeric(value),
        horizon = as.integer(horizon) + 1L  # Convert 0-based to 1-based
      ) %>%
      select(model, forecast_date, reference_date, horizon, target_end_date, location, output_type_id, value)
    ens_list[[cdc_date]] <- df
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(sprintf("Could not fetch ensemble from GitHub for %s: %s", cdc_date, e$message))
  })
}

# Load all local ensemble files
for (local_file in local_ens_files) {
  # Extract date from filename
  m <- regexpr("\\d{8}", basename(local_file))
  local_cdc_date <- regmatches(basename(local_file), m)

  tryCatch({
    df <- read_csv(local_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%

}

test_hedge_backtest_df <- load_test_hedge_backtest_files()
if (!is.null(test_hedge_backtest_df) && nrow(test_hedge_backtest_df) > 0) {

# Load all local meta ensemble files
meta_list <- list()
for (local_file in local_meta_files) {
  # Extract date from filename
  m <- regexpr("\\d{8}", basename(local_file))
  local_cdc_date <- regmatches(basename(local_file), m)

  tryCatch({
    df <- read_csv(local_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%

      ) %>%

  }, error = function(e) {

  })
}

if (length(meta_list) > 0) {
  all_forecasts[['AdaptiveEnsemble-meta']] <- bind_rows(meta_list)
}

# Load directory-local joint model prospective output
test_joint_df <- load_test_joint_prosp_file()
if (!is.null(test_joint_df) && nrow(test_joint_df) > 0) {
  all_forecasts[[TEST_JOINT_MODEL]] <- test_joint_df
}

test_joint_backtest_df <- load_test_joint_backtest_file()
if (!is.null(test_joint_backtest_df) && nrow(test_joint_backtest_df) > 0) {
  all_forecasts[[paste0(TEST_JOINT_MODEL, '-backtest')]] <- test_joint_backtest_df
}

test_knn_backtest_df <- load_test_knn_backtest_file()
if (!is.null(test_knn_backtest_df) && nrow(test_knn_backtest_df) > 0) {
  all_forecasts[[paste0(KNN_TEST_MODEL, '-backtest')]] <- test_knn_backtest_df
}

# Combine all forecasts
forecasts_all <- bind_rows(all_forecasts) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value))

# Get all unique forecast dates
all_forecast_dates <- sort(unique(forecasts_all$forecast_date), decreasing = TRUE)
latest_date <- if (length(all_forecast_dates) > 0) all_forecast_dates[1] else ""

# Format dates for display (YYYYMMDD -> YYYY-MM-DD)
format_date_display <- function(d) {
  paste0(substr(d, 1, 4), "-", substr(d, 5, 6), "-", substr(d, 7, 8))
}

date_choices <- setNames(all_forecast_dates, sapply(all_forecast_dates, format_date_display))

# Summarize quantiles per model/horizon/location/forecast_date
forecast_summary <- forecasts_all %>%
  group_by(model, horizon, forecast_date, reference_date, target_end_date, location) %>%
  summarise(
    q025 = value[which.min(abs(output_type_id - 0.025))],
    q25 = value[which.min(abs(output_type_id - 0.25))],
    median = value[which.min(abs(output_type_id - 0.5))],
    q75 = value[which.min(abs(output_type_id - 0.75))],
    q975 = value[which.min(abs(output_type_id - 0.975))],
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    q025 = pmin(q025, q25, median, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = pmin(q25, median, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = pmax(q75, median, na.rm = TRUE),
    q975 = pmax(q975, q75, median, na.rm = TRUE),
    location_name = fips_to_name[location]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(location_name))

# Available models
all_models <- sort(unique(forecast_summary$model))
```

```{r}
# Date selector with backward/forward navigation
h4("Forecast Date")

selectInput(
  "forecast_date",
  NULL,
  choices = date_choices,
  selected = latest_date
)

# Navigation buttons
fluidRow(
  column(6, actionButton("prev_date", "<< Prev", width = "100%")),
  column(6, actionButton("next_date", "Next >>", width = "100%"))
)

# Update date on button clicks
observeEvent(input$prev_date, {
  current_idx <- which(all_forecast_dates == input$forecast_date)
  if (current_idx < length(all_forecast_dates)) {
    updateSelectInput(session, "forecast_date", selected = all_forecast_dates[current_idx + 1])
  }
})

observeEvent(input$next_date, {
  current_idx <- which(all_forecast_dates == input$forecast_date)
  if (current_idx > 1) {
    updateSelectInput(session, "forecast_date", selected = all_forecast_dates[current_idx - 1])
  }
})

hr()

checkboxGroupInput(
  "models",
  "Select Models:",
  choices = all_models,
  selected = all_models[1:min(3, length(all_models))]
)

hr()

selectizeInput(
  "states",
  "Select States:",
  choices = all_states,
  selected = NULL,
  multiple = TRUE,
  options = list(
    placeholder = "All states (click to filter)",
    plugins = list('remove_button')
  )
)

hr()

checkboxInput("show_95ci", "Show 95% CI", value = TRUE)
checkboxInput("show_50ci", "Show 50% CI", value = TRUE)
checkboxInput("show_median", "Show Median", value = TRUE)

hr()

p("Black line = Ground Truth")
p(paste("Dates available:", length(all_forecast_dates)))
p("Generated:", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d"))
p(paste("Models found:", length(all_models)))
```

State Forecasts
=====================================

Row
-------------------------------------

```{r}
renderPlot({
  req(input$models, input$forecast_date)

  # Filter to selected models and forecast date, exclude US and PR
  fc_data <- forecast_summary %>%
    filter(model %in% input$models,
           forecast_date == input$forecast_date,
           !location %in% c('US', '72'))

  actuals <- actual_data %>% filter(!location %in% c('US', '72'))

  # Apply state filter if any states are selected
  if (!is.null(input$states) && length(input$states) > 0) {
    fc_data <- fc_data %>% filter(location_name %in% input$states)
    actuals <- actuals %>% filter(location_name %in% input$states)
  }

  # Determine number of columns based on number of states
  n_states <- length(unique(fc_data$location_name))
  if (n_states == 0) n_states <- 1
  ncols <- if (n_states == 1) 1 else if (n_states <= 4) 2 else if (n_states <= 9) 3 else if (n_states <= 16) 4 else 6

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = actuals, aes(x = date, y = actual_value), color = 'black', linewidth = 0.5)

  # Use ribbons for CI bands (connected across horizons)
  if (input$show_95ci && nrow(fc_data) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_ribbon(
      data = fc_data,
      aes(x = target_end_date, ymin = q025, ymax = q975, fill = model, group = model),
      alpha = 0.2
    )
  }

  if (input$show_50ci && nrow(fc_data) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_ribbon(
      data = fc_data,
      aes(x = target_end_date, ymin = q25, ymax = q75, fill = model, group = model),
      alpha = 0.35
    )
  }

  if (input$show_median && nrow(fc_data) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_line(
      data = fc_data,
      aes(x = target_end_date, y = median, color = model, group = model),
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = fc_data,
      aes(x = target_end_date, y = median, color = model),
      size = 1.5
    )
  }

  # Add vertical reference line at forecast date
  ref_date <- as.Date(format_date_display(input$forecast_date))

  # Adjust text size based on number of facets
  base_size <- if (n_states <= 4) 12 else if (n_states <= 9) 11 else 10
  strip_size <- if (n_states <= 4) 11 else if (n_states <= 9) 9 else 8

  p + facet_wrap(~ location_name, scales = 'free_y', ncol = ncols) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = ref_date, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = model_colors, drop = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = model_fills, drop = TRUE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text = element_text(size = strip_size),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Prospective Forecasts (", format_date_display(input$forecast_date), ") - All Horizons"),
      subtitle = if (is.null(input$states) || length(input$states) == 0)
        "Bands show uncertainty across horizons 1-4 weeks ahead (all states). Dashed line = forecast date."
        else paste0("Selected: ", paste(input$states, collapse = ", "), ". Dashed line = forecast date."),
      x = "Date",
      y = "Weekly Hospitalizations",
      color = "Model",
      fill = "Model"
    )
}, height = function() {
  # Dynamic height based on number of states
  n_states <- if (is.null(input$states) || length(input$states) == 0) 50 else length(input$states)
  if (n_states == 1) 400 else if (n_states <= 4) 500 else if (n_states <= 9) 700 else if (n_states <= 16) 850 else 1000
})
```
